summary.en: A source document as an object: a page of title, meta and sections that can scroll in its frame and mark any line.
summary.zh: 作为物件的来源文档：标题、元信息和分节正文的一页，能在框里滚动，能给任意一行划上荧光笔。

fits: Any scene that needs the source a claim comes from on screen: a brief, a report, a contract, a paper; written lines where they matter and skeleton lines elsewhere.
notFor: A real screenshot of a product page (use the film's own asset); reading a whole document (only the marked lines are meant to be read); code (use an editor prop).

overlaps.note: the note layout is a card in a set; doc-page is one tall page with sections, scroll and marks

intent.en: Keep the source on screen, so every claim drawn from it visibly comes from a real document instead of floating in the air.
intent.zh: 让来源文档留在画面里，从它引出的每条结论都看得出出处，而不是空中楼阁。

content.en: A document's title, one meta line and 6–40 lines of headings and paragraphs; only 1–3 evidence lines need real text (en ≤ 64 chars, zh ≤ 28 chars), the rest can be skeleton bars.
content.zh: 一份文档的标题、一行元信息、6–40 行小标题与正文；只有 1–3 行证据句需要真文字（英文 ≤ 64 字符，中文 ≤ 28 字），其余可以是骨架条。

fits.zh: 任何需要把结论的出处摆上屏的场景：需求简报、报告、合同、论文；要紧的几行写真文字，其余用骨架行。

notFor.zh: 产品页面的真实截图（用影片自己的素材）；让观众读完整份文档（只有划线的那几行是给人读的）；代码（用编辑器类道具）。

pairs.note: the scene that parks this page and deals findings from its marked lines

en: The text must be longer than the whole scroll, or the page scrolls into blank space at the end.
Write real text only on the lines that are read; a page full of readable sentences pulls the eye off the findings.
zh: 正文要比整段滚动行程长，否则末段滚出空白。
只在要读的几行写真文字；满页可读的句子会把视线从结论上拉走。

upstream.name: 文档驻留发牌
upstream.summary: 文档不淡出而是向左滑出只露约 35% 宽并微缩到 0.92，右侧按旁白节奏慢速发牌三张白底描边药丸（outBack 弹入），每张落定后其下方字幕逐词加深、下一张到来前整句淡出，左侧文档全程极缓慢自动滚动保持"正在被读"
upstream.use: 旁白驱动的"分析结论逐条给出"段落；文档理解、推荐理由、审阅意见类产品的核心说明镜头
upstream.energy: 低（慢发牌节奏，全片无峰值；靠自动滚动维持活性）
